text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 11, 2024) for 725 Eglinton Avenue West

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (July 11, 2024) for 725 Eglinton Avenue West, Folder Number 24 178350 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to November 5, 2024 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
